entries.name: Victini
entries.rationale: Height 4 gives no reach to handle a shot, so HAN drops; weight 40 already holds PHY at 65 and height already lowers DIV, so those stand. The flat 100 base stats, humanoid shape and kickMoves blaze-kick and mega-kick keep it a complete attacking mid.

entries.name: Snivy
entries.rationale: Spe 63 is its best stat and the upright snake shape at height 0.6 m suits quick wide running; tiny forelimbs cut HAN, and weight 8.1 kg gives no physical presence.

entries.name: Servine
entries.rationale: Spe 83 and a light 16 kg upright frame make a nimble wide player; the Grass Snake genus and small forelimbs argue against goalkeeping, so HAN drops despite def 75.

entries.name: Serperior
entries.rationale: Squiggle shape at height 3.3 m gives a long blocking reach and spe 113 covers ground, but no legs means little footwork; the Regal genus fits a composed reader of play, so VIS rises.

entries.name: Tepig
entries.rationale: Quadruped shape at height 0.5 m with no hands rules out goal, while atk 63 over spe 45 and kickMoves head-smash point to a direct, head-first forward; Layer 1 quadruped and move mods already cover it.

entries.name: Pignite
entries.rationale: Atk 93 and hp 90 on an upright 55.5 kg frame with kickMoves low-kick and low-sweep make a powerful forward or stopper; spe 55 keeps it off the wing, and Layer 1 already credits the kicks.

entries.name: Emboar
entries.rationale: Atk 123, hp 110 and weight 150 kg make a battering ram, so PHY rises, but a fist-fighting brawler does not earn TEC 98 or PAS 79 from move counts alone; ability Reckless fits a direct striker.

entries.name: Oshawott
entries.rationale: Height 0.5 m and weight 5.9 kg leave no physical base, so it plays as a small upright technician off spa 63; base stats are uniformly low and no adjustment is warranted.

entries.name: Dewott
entries.rationale: Genus Discipline and its dual-blade fighting style suit a tidy, well-drilled central mid, so TEC gets a small lift; spe 60 and weight 24.5 kg keep it off the flanks and out of duels.

entries.name: Samurott
entries.rationale: Quadruped shape at weight 94.6 kg gives a powerful but unhandy frame, so TEC and PAS ease from the spa 108 driven baseline; genus Formidable and its foreleg blades fit a hard-tackling centre-back.

entries.name: Patrat
entries.rationale: All base stats sit between 35 and 55 at weight 11.6 kg; genus Scout with abilities Keen Eye and Analytic already lifted VIS in Layer 1, so it stays a lightweight wide runner with no change.

entries.name: Watchog
entries.rationale: Upright frame at height 1.1 m with atk 85 and spe 77 gives a balanced wide attacker; genus Lookout and ability Keen Eye are already reflected in Layer 1's VIS bonus, so no further change.

entries.name: Lillipup
entries.rationale: Height 0.4 m and weight 4.1 kg make a tiny quadruped with ACC 61 off spe 55; ability Vital Spirit already added STA in Layer 1, so it stays an energetic wide runner with no adjustment.

entries.name: Herdier
entries.rationale: Ability Intimidate already pushed TAK in Layer 1, and genus Loyal Dog fits a dogged marker; quadruped shape and spa 35 leave little passing, so it slots at the back with no further change.

entries.name: Stoutland
entries.rationale: Atk 110 with def and spd 90 on a 61 kg quadruped makes a sturdy marking defender; with paws and no hands HAN trims further, and genus Big-Hearted fits a high work-rate role.

entries.name: Purrloin
entries.rationale: Spe 66 and ACC 76 on a 10.1 kg quadruped favour quick, sly wide play; genus Devious and ability Prankster suit an unpredictable winger, and def 37 rules out defending.

entries.name: Liepard
entries.rationale: Spe 106 and a lean 37.5 kg quadruped frame make an elusive winger, and abilities Unburden and Prankster fit its trickery; paws rather than feet limit striking technique, so TEC trims.

entries.name: Pansage
entries.rationale: Grass Monkey genus and upright shape give hands and nimble feet, and spe 64 is its top stat; at height 0.6 m it lacks presence, so it plays small and wide with Layer 1's kick bonuses left as is.

entries.name: Simisage
entries.rationale: Balanced atk and spa 98 with spe 101 on a light 30.5 kg upright monkey frame already read as a creative forward; the Layer 1 bonus from kickMoves low-kick and low-sweep covers its footwork, so no change.

entries.name: Pansear
entries.rationale: Identical base stats to its grass and water siblings (spe 64, atk and spa 53) on an 11 kg upright monkey body; it projects as a small, quick attacker and warrants no adjustment.

entries.name: Simisear
entries.rationale: Spe 101 with atk and spa 98 on an upright 28 kg frame, plus kickMoves blaze-kick, already lifted SHO and KIC in Layer 1; that separates it from its siblings, so no further change.

entries.name: Panpour
entries.rationale: Genus Spray shares the monkey trio's spe 64 and atk 53 with a slightly heavier 13.5 kg build; upright shape gives usable feet and hands, but low base stats keep it a fringe wide attacker.

entries.name: Simipour
entries.rationale: Upright 29 kg frame with spe 101 and atk and spa 98 mirrors Simisage; it reads as a flair forward, and the baseline already ranks W, AM and ST correctly.

entries.name: Munna
entries.rationale: Spe 24 and atk 25 leave nothing for attacking, while hp 76 and ability Forewarn suit a sitting, anticipating role; the floating quadruped shape gives no kicking power, consistent with the baseline.

entries.name: Musharna
entries.rationale: Spe 29 with hp 116 and spa 107 make a stationary playmaker; the humanoid shape tag overstates its stubby limbs, so HAN, DRI and TEC ease, and genus Drowsing argues against any running role.

entries.name: Pidove
entries.rationale: Height 0.3 m and weight 2.1 kg with wings shape give flight but no physical game; base stats top out at atk 55, and Layer 1 wing mods already cover AER, so no change.

entries.name: Tranquill
entries.rationale: Wings shape at weight 15 kg with atk 77 and spe 65 suits a mid-sized aerial runner; Layer 1 wing mods already handle AER and ball skills, so no adjustment.

entries.name: Unfezant
entries.rationale: Atk 115 and spe 93 with wings shape give a powerful aerial forward; genus Proud carries no football signal and Layer 1 already rewarded flight, so the baseline stands.

entries.name: Blitzle
entries.rationale: Quadruped zebra at weight 29.8 kg with spe 76 and kickMoves double-kick favours raw running on the flank; def 32 and hp 45 make it fragile, which the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Zebstrika
entries.rationale: Spe 116 on a 79.5 kg quadruped makes an outright sprinter and kickMoves double-kick gives power, but hooves do not deliver fine touch, so TEC and DRI come down from the spe and atk driven baseline.

entries.name: Roggenrola
entries.rationale: Spe 15 and def 85 on a 0.4 m, 18 kg rock body make a slow, sturdy blocker; ability Sturdy fits a stay-at-home role, and the baseline already reflects it.

entries.name: Boldore
entries.rationale: Weight 102 kg with atk and def 105 and spe 20 make an immovable centre-back; the tentacles shape already cut ball skills in Layer 1, so no change.

entries.name: Gigalith
entries.rationale: Weight 260 kg with atk 135 and def 130 is the archetypal wall at centre-back; spe 25 rules out any wide role, and crystal limbs rather than hands justify trimming the tentacles-driven HAN.

entries.name: Woobat
entries.rationale: A 2.1 kg bat with spe 72 and wings shape is all flight and quickness with no strength; Layer 1 wing mods already lower TEC and lift AER, so no adjustment.

entries.name: Swoobat
entries.rationale: Spe 114 at weight 10.5 kg with wings makes a fast, flighty wide player; low atk 57 and def 55 keep it out of the middle, and the baseline already ranks W, WM and WB first.

entries.name: Drilbur
entries.rationale: A 0.3 m mole with atk 85 and spe 68 is a quick, burrowing nuisance up front; claw hands and short legs do not justify DRI 88, so it trims, and the tiny frame rules out aerial work.

entries.name: Excadrill
entries.rationale: Atk 135 and hp 110 on a compact 0.7 m, 40.4 kg body make a powerful drilling forward; the short height argues against aerial duels, so AER drops, and spa 50 keeps passing modest.

entries.name: Audino
entries.rationale: Hp 103 with def and spd 86 and abilities Healer and Regenerator suit a tireless, supportive holding mid; spe 50 keeps it central, and the baseline already says so.

entries.name: Timburr
entries.rationale: Genus Muscular and abilities Guts and Iron Fist describe a small brawler with atk 80 but spe 35; Layer 1 already credited its long kickMoves list, so the baseline stands.

entries.name: Gurdurr
entries.rationale: Atk 105 and def 85 on a 40 kg upright frame with spe 40 make a combative centre-back or holding mid; the Muscular genus fits, and Layer 1's kick bonuses already lift SHO and TAK.

entries.name: Conkeldurr
entries.rationale: Atk 140 and weight 87 kg make a destroyer in duels, but it is designed leaning on two concrete pillars and has spe 45, so the move-driven TEC and KIC are trimmed.

entries.name: Tympole
entries.rationale: Fish shape at height 0.5 m has no legs, and Layer 1 already stripped its ball skills heavily; with spe 64 its only asset, it is a marginal wide option and needs no further cut.

entries.name: Palpitoad
entries.rationale: Hp 75 and spe 69 on a squat 17 kg toad body suit a tireless wide-to-central runner; stubby legs do not support DRI 70, so it trims slightly.

entries.name: Seismitoad
entries.rationale: Hp 105 with atk 95 and spa 85 on a stocky 62 kg humanoid body gives an all-round central presence; spe 74 is middling, so it belongs in the middle rather than wide, matching the baseline.

entries.name: Throh
entries.rationale: Genus Judo with hp 120 and atk 100 describes a grappler who wins body contests, so PHY rises a little; spe 45 keeps it in a deep defensive role.

entries.name: Sawk
entries.rationale: Genus Karate with atk 125, spe 85 and kickMoves double-kick and mega-kick makes a striking forward; Layer 1 move bonuses also inflated HAN and DIV, which a kicker does not earn, so both trim.

entries.name: Sewaddle
entries.rationale: Def 70 is its best stat on a 0.3 m, 2.5 kg caterpillar body with armor shape, so it plays as a small, cautious defender; nothing in the fields calls for a change.

entries.name: Swadloon
entries.rationale: Def 90 and spd 80 make a tough little blocker, but genus Leaf-Wrapped means a body bundled in leaves at height 0.5 m, so the arms-driven HAN boost is trimmed and it plays in front of goal rather than in it.

entries.name: Leavanny
entries.rationale: Spe 92 and atk 103 on a slim 20.5 kg humanoid with kickMoves triple-axel suit a nimble attacker, but its forelimbs are leaf blades, so the humanoid HAN bonus is cut hard.

entries.name: Venipede
entries.rationale: A 5.3 kg armor-shaped centipede with spe 57 and ability Speed Boost, already rewarded in Layer 1; many small legs give scuttle speed but no kicking, so no change.

entries.name: Whirlipede
entries.rationale: Ball shape with def 99 and weight 58.5 kg is a rolling shell that blocks but cannot touch the ball cleanly; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills, so it is a pure stopper with no change.

entries.name: Scolipede
entries.rationale: Spe 112 and weight 200.5 kg make a charging monster that wins races and collisions, but a long armor-shaped centipede has no diving body for goal, so DIV drops; spa 55 limits passing.

entries.name: Cottonee
entries.rationale: Weight 0.6 kg and ball shape make a drifting cotton puff with no strength or kick, already reflected in Layer 1; ability Prankster suits an unpredictable nuisance out wide.

entries.name: Whimsicott
entries.rationale: Spe 116 and ability Prankster make a tricky, darting wide player, but a 6.6 kg cotton-wrapped body has little real touch or grip, so the humanoid-driven DRI and HAN are trimmed.

entries.name: Petilil
entries.rationale: Blob shape at height 0.5 m with spe 30 gives no legs to speak of, and Layer 1 already cut its ball skills; ability Own Tempo and spa 70 suit a passive central role.

entries.name: Lilligant
entries.rationale: Spa 110 and spe 90 make a fluent playmaker, and its signature Quiver Dance identity points to balance and poise that the blob shape penalty understates, so DRI and TEC recover a few points.

entries.name: Basculin
entries.rationale: Fish shape removes its legs and Layer 1 cut its ball skills to match, but atk 92, spe 98, kickMoves head-smash and genus Hostile leave a headstrong attacker who threatens mainly with its head.

entries.name: Sandile
entries.rationale: Atk 72 and spe 65 on a 15.2 kg quadruped with abilities Intimidate and Moxie make a snappy, aggressive runner; Layer 1 already gave the Intimidate TAK bonus, so no change.

entries.name: Krokorok
entries.rationale: Quadruped at weight 33.4 kg with atk 82 and spe 74, plus kickMoves low-kick and mega-kick, reads as a direct, aggressive forward; the baseline already ranks W and ST first.

entries.name: Krookodile
entries.rationale: Atk 117 and spe 92 on a 96.3 kg upright frame give a powerful, quick forward who can also defend; genus Intimidation and ability Intimidate fit its menace, already credited to TAK in Layer 1.

entries.name: Darumaka
entries.rationale: Atk 90 with ability Hustle gives an eager, heavy hitter, but a round 0.6 m daruma body with stubby limbs earns less than the humanoid tag gives, so DRI and HAN are trimmed.

entries.name: Darmanitan
entries.rationale: Atk 140 and spe 95 on a 92.9 kg quadruped body with ability Sheer Force make a blunt, explosive forward; spa 30 offers no creativity, which the low PAS and VIS already show.

entries.name: Maractus
entries.rationale: Spa 106 drives a decent passing range, but blob shape and spe 60 leave a rooted cactus with poor mobility; Layer 1's blob mods already capture that, so it is a static central passer with no change.

entries.name: Dwebble
entries.rationale: Def 85 and a stone shell on a 0.3 m armor-shaped crab give a sturdy but tiny blocker; Layer 1 already added PHY for the shell, so no change.

entries.name: Crustle
entries.rationale: Weight 200 kg with def 125 and the Stone Home shell makes a static, unbreakable centre-back; spe 45 rules out the flanks and Layer 1 already rewarded its bulk.

entries.name: Scraggy
entries.rationale: Its kick-heavy move list including high-jump-kick and head-smash already lifted SHO, TEC and KIC in Layer 1; at height 0.6 m and spe 48 it remains a scrappy, combative player with no further change.

entries.name: Scrafty
entries.rationale: Def and spd 115 with ability Intimidate make a tough, combative defender, but genus Hoodlum points to an enforcer rather than a keeper, so HAN trims; spe 58 keeps it central.

entries.name: Sigilyph
entries.rationale: Spa 103 and spe 97 with wings shape give a light, mobile creator who floats over play; weight 14 kg and atk 58 offer no physical edge, matching the baseline.

entries.name: Yamask
entries.rationale: Def 85 is its only real asset on a 1.5 kg ghost body with spe 30; the arms shape already raised HAN, so it is a fringe defensive option with no change.

entries.name: Cofagrigus
entries.rationale: Def 145 and a 1.7 m coffin body make a natural goal-blocker, and its design's four large shadow hands earn back the HAN that the blob shape took away; spe 30 rules out outfield running.

entries.name: Tirtouga
entries.rationale: Def 103 and spe 22 on a 16.5 kg quadruped turtle make a slow, sturdy stopper; abilities Solid Rock and Sturdy fit a block-first role already reflected in the baseline.

entries.name: Carracosta
entries.rationale: Def 133 and atk 108 at weight 81 kg make a rock-solid centre-back, but its limbs are flippers, so the upright-driven TEC and HAN are trimmed; spe 32 keeps it deep.

entries.name: Archen
entries.rationale: Atk 112 on a 9.5 kg winged body gives a sharp, punchy forward; ability Defeatist already cut STA in Layer 1, and def 45 keeps it out of defence, so no change.

entries.name: Archeops
entries.rationale: Atk 140 and spe 110 with wings shape make an explosive aerial attacker; ability Defeatist makes it fade once worn down, which Layer 1 applied to STA, and def 65 keeps it forward.

entries.name: Trubbish
entries.rationale: A 0.6 m trash bag with stubby limbs earns less than the humanoid shape's DRI and HAN bonuses, so both are trimmed; spe 65 and def 62 leave a scrappy full-back, and ability Stench fits an off-putting presence.

entries.name: Garbodor
entries.rationale: Height 1.9 m and weight 107.3 kg with long garbage arms suit a blocking centre-back or keeper; a lumbering trash-heap body does not support DRI 67, so it is trimmed.

entries.name: Zorua
entries.rationale: Genus Tricky Fox and ability Illusion define a deceiver, which on a pitch means feints and disguised runs, so DRI rises; def 40 and weight 12.5 kg keep it away from defending.

entries.name: Zoroark
entries.rationale: Spa 120, atk 105 and spe 105 on an agile 81.1 kg upright frame make a creative forward, and ability Illusion fits a deceptive dribbler, so DRI gets a small lift; def 60 makes it fragile.

entries.name: Minccino
entries.rationale: A 5.8 kg quadruped with spe 75 and ACC 80 is a darting wide runner; abilities Technician and Skill Link already nudged TEC and SHO in Layer 1, so no change.

entries.name: Cinccino
entries.rationale: Spe 115 with abilities Technician and Skill Link make a slick, quick winger, but height 0.5 m and weight 7.5 kg give no aerial presence, so AER drops a little.

entries.name: Gothita
entries.rationale: Spd 65 and spa 55 on a 0.4 m humanoid body give a small, careful playmaker; Layer 1 already added the humanoid ball skills, and there is nothing further to correct.

entries.name: Gothorita
entries.rationale: Spd 85 and spa 75 with spe 55 suit a deliberate central passer; genus Manipulate fits a controlling midfielder, and the baseline needs no change.

entries.name: Gothitelle
entries.rationale: Spd 110 and spa 95 with spe 65 give a composed deep playmaker, and ability Shadow Tag, which stops opponents escaping, fits tight marking; the baseline already reflects this.

entries.name: Solosis
entries.rationale: A 1 kg ball-shaped cell with spa 105 and spe 20 has vision but no legs or strength; Layer 1 ball mods already stripped its ball skills, so no change.

entries.name: Duosion
entries.rationale: Spa 125 is its standout stat, but the ball shape and spe 30 make it a static thinker with no footwork; Layer 1 already handled the shape, so it stays a deep central option.

entries.name: Reuniclus
entries.rationale: Hp 110 and spa 125 with spe 30 make a slow, cerebral holding mid; its large gel arms already earned the arms-shape HAN bonus in Layer 1, so no change.

entries.name: Ducklett
entries.rationale: A 5.5 kg water bird with spe 55 and atk 44 has flight but little else; ability Keen Eye and the wings mods already applied in Layer 1, so no adjustment.

entries.name: Swanna
entries.rationale: Spe 98 with balanced atk and spa 87 and wings shape give an elegant, mobile attacker; height 1.3 m and a long neck support the aerial game Layer 1 already rewarded.

entries.name: Vanillite
entries.rationale: Blob shape at height 0.4 m, an ice cream cone body with no legs, and spe 44; Layer 1 blob mods already cover the lack of footwork, so no change.

entries.name: Vanillish
entries.rationale: Spa 80 and spd 75 on a legless 41 kg blob give little mobility, so it is best planted in a deep or goal-line role, as the baseline already suggests.

entries.name: Vanilluxe
entries.rationale: Heads shape with two cones and no legs means atk 95 and spa 110 cannot translate into kicking, so TEC and KIC are cut further; two heads at height 1.3 m make it a useful header of the ball.

entries.name: Deerling
entries.rationale: Spe 75 on a light 19.5 kg fawn with kickMoves double-kick and jump-kick favours quick flank running; Layer 1 already credited the kicks, so no change.

entries.name: Sawsbuck
entries.rationale: Height 1.9 m and weight 92.5 kg with spe 95 and antlers make a tall, fast target forward; quadruped shape limits passing, as the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Emolga
entries.rationale: Spe 103 on a 5 kg glider makes a darting winger, and genus Sky Squirrel with flying type supports a small AER lift; at height 0.4 m it has no physical presence.

entries.name: Karrablast
entries.rationale: Atk 75 and spe 60 on a 5.9 kg body with genus Clamping fit a snapping, aggressive forward; nothing in its fields contradicts the baseline.

entries.name: Escavalier
entries.rationale: Atk 135 and def 105 make a fierce tackler, but genus Cavalry means its arms are lances, so the arms-shape HAN and DIV bonuses are cut hard; spe 20 pins it in central defence.

entries.name: Foongus
entries.rationale: Height 0.2 m and spe 15 make a tiny, nearly static mushroom; hp 69 is its only asset, and the baseline already leaves it near the bottom of every role.

entries.name: Amoonguss
entries.rationale: Hp 114 and ability Regenerator give a durable, tireless holding mid. Layer 1 already applied KIC -8 for the arms shape, but a 0.6 m mushroom with cap-shaped arms does not merit HAN 85, so it is trimmed.

entries.name: Frillish
entries.rationale: Spd 85 is its best stat on a floating jellyfish body with tentacles shape and spe 40; Layer 1 tentacle mods already handled its lack of feet, so no change.

entries.name: Jellicent
entries.rationale: Height 2.2 m and weight 135 kg with hp 100 and long tentacles make a large, enveloping presence in front of or in goal; spe 60 rules out running roles, matching the baseline.

entries.name: Alomomola
entries.rationale: Hp 165 and ability Healer give enormous staying power and a supportive identity, but fish shape removes legs, which Layer 1 already penalized; it is a static blocker at the back.

entries.name: Joltik
entries.rationale: Height 0.1 m and weight 0.6 kg make the shortest body in the generation, with spe 65 its only real asset; the armor-shape PHY bonus from Layer 1 does not fit so tiny a body, so PHY trims.

entries.name: Galvantula
entries.rationale: Spe 108 and spa 97 on a light 14.3 kg spider body suit a quick, creative wide player; ability Compound Eyes already lifted VIS in Layer 1, so no change.

entries.name: Ferroseed
entries.rationale: Spe 10 and def 91 on a spiked ball body make an immobile obstacle; ability Iron Barbs punishes anyone who challenges it, a defensive identity already reflected in the baseline.

entries.name: Ferrothorn
entries.rationale: Def 131 and spd 116 at weight 110 kg with spe 20 make a spiked, immovable centre-back; ability Iron Barbs makes every challenge costly, and the baseline already reflects its slowness.

entries.name: Klink
entries.rationale: Two interlocking gears at height 0.3 m with spe 30 have no hands or legs, so HAN trims; abilities Plus and Minus are about pairing with a partner, which fits teamwork.

entries.name: Klang
entries.rationale: Def 95 and spd 85 on a 51 kg gear body with spe 50 suit a steady screening role; gears cannot catch, so HAN trims, and abilities Plus and Minus fit a cooperative unit.

entries.name: Klinklang
entries.rationale: Def 115 and spe 90 make a fast, sturdy defender, but heads shape gears with no hands or feet cannot catch or strike cleanly, so HAN and TEC drop below the stat-driven baseline.

entries.name: Tynamo
entries.rationale: Weight 0.3 kg and fish shape with no limbs make it the lightest body in the generation; Layer 1 already stripped its skills, and ability Levitate does not help on the ball.

entries.name: Eelektrik
entries.rationale: Fish shape and ability Levitate leave an eel that floats without legs, so Layer 1 pace and ball-skill cuts stand; atk 85 and def 70 still make it a usable central blocker.

entries.name: Eelektross
entries.rationale: Atk 115 and spa 105 on a 2.1 m, 80.5 kg eel make a big central presence; it has clawed arms that the fish shape ignores, so some HAN returns, but no legs keeps pace and footwork low.

entries.name: Elgyem
entries.rationale: Spa 85 and abilities Telepathy and Analytic suit a small cerebral playmaker; spe 30 and weight 9 kg give no running or physical game, as the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Beheeyem
entries.rationale: Spa 125 and spd 95 with ability Telepathy make an elite deep-lying passer; spe 40 means it dictates from the middle rather than running, which the baseline already shows.

entries.name: Litwick
entries.rationale: Height 0.3 m candle body with blob shape and spe 20 has no legs to play on; Layer 1 already cut it heavily, so no further change.

entries.name: Lampent
entries.rationale: Spa 95 on a floating 13 kg lamp with spe 55 supports some creative passing; its small arms already earned the Layer 1 HAN bonus, and nothing else needs correcting.

entries.name: Chandelure
entries.rationale: Spa 145 gives elite vision and passing range, and its floating chandelier body with spread arms suits covering goal, but with no legs KIC stays low; the baseline already balances these.

entries.name: Axew
entries.rationale: Atk 87 on a small 0.6 m upright dragon with tusks gives a punchy young forward; spe 57 and hp 46 limit it, and the baseline already ranks ST and W first.

entries.name: Fraxure
entries.rationale: Atk 117 with spe 67 on an upright 36 kg frame makes a direct forward who can also win the ball; ability Mold Breaker and genus Axe Jaw fit an aggressive style already captured.

entries.name: Haxorus
entries.rationale: Atk 147 and spe 97 at weight 105.5 kg make a ferocious centre-forward who can also defend; small forelimbs and axe tusks argue against goal, so the spe-driven DIV drops.

entries.name: Cubchoo
entries.rationale: Atk 70 with low-kick and mega-kick in kickMoves gives a sturdy little forward, but spe 40 and height 0.5 m keep it slow and light; the baseline already reflects this.

entries.name: Beartic
entries.rationale: Height 2.6 m and weight 260 kg with atk 130 make a giant enforcer at the back; spe 50 limits mobility, and the quadruped mods already lowered ball skills, so no change.

entries.name: Cryogonal
entries.rationale: Spe 105 and spd 135 on a floating snowflake with ball shape give quick reactions and coverage but no limbs to strike with; Layer 1 already cut ball skills, so no change.

entries.name: Shelmet
entries.rationale: Def 85 and spe 25 in a 7.7 kg snail shell make a slow, armoured blocker; ball shape mods already strip its ball skills, so no change.

entries.name: Accelgor
entries.rationale: Spe 145 is the highest in the generation, and ability Unburden plus its ninja design fit a blistering winger; the arms-shape PAC cut in Layer 1 undersells that, so PAC rises.

entries.name: Stunfisk
entries.rationale: Hp 109 and def 84 on a flat 11 kg fish with spe 32 make a trap-setter that lies in wait; genus Trap fits positional defending, and Layer 1's fish mods already remove its mobility.

entries.name: Mienfoo
entries.rationale: Genus Martial Arts and kickMoves high-jump-kick, jump-kick and low-sweep already gave large Layer 1 kick bonuses; atk 85 and spe 65 on a light 20 kg frame leave a nimble young striker, so no change.

entries.name: Mienshao
entries.rationale: Atk 125 and spe 105 with an 11-move kickMoves list, tied for the generation's longest and running from high-jump-kick to triple-axel, make a complete striker; Layer 1 already maxed its kicking, and def 60 marks it as fragile.

entries.name: Druddigon
entries.rationale: Atk 120 and def 90 at weight 139 kg make a heavy, physical stopper; spe 48 limits mobility and ability Rough Skin punishes contact, all consistent with the baseline.

entries.name: Golett
entries.rationale: Weight 92 kg at height 1.0 m with spe 35 makes a heavy, clumsy automaton; the humanoid and kickMoves bonuses from Layer 1 are already enough, so no change.

entries.name: Golurk
entries.rationale: Height 2.8 m and weight 330 kg with atk 124 make a towering presence, dominant in the air at both ends; spe 55 and ACC 34 keep it central, and the baseline already says so.

entries.name: Pawniard
entries.rationale: Atk 85 and spe 60 on a 10.2 kg body suit a sharp, aggressive forward; genus Sharp Blade and its bladed hands do not support the Layer 1 HAN bonus, so it trims.

entries.name: Bisharp
entries.rationale: Atk 125 and def 100 make a hard-tackling centre-back or forward, but genus Sword Blade means blades for hands, so the HAN and DIV bonuses from Layer 1 are cut; spe 70 with ACC 56 is not quick off the mark.

entries.name: Bouffalant
entries.rationale: Genus Bash Buffalo and kickMoves headbutt and skull-bash describe a head-first charger, so AER edges up; hp 95 and atk 110 on 94.6 kg suit a tireless, physical centre-back.

entries.name: Rufflet
entries.rationale: Atk 83 on a 10.5 kg eaglet with wings shape and abilities Sheer Force and Hustle makes a brave, combative young forward; Layer 1 wing mods already apply.

entries.name: Braviary
entries.rationale: Atk 123 and hp 100 with wings at height 1.5 m make a commanding aerial player at either end; genus Valiant and ability Defiant fit an aggressive, brave style the baseline already captures.

entries.name: Vullaby
entries.rationale: Def 75 and hp 70 on a 9 kg winged body with atk 55 make a defensive-minded flank player; abilities Big Pecks and Overcoat are defensive, and the baseline already ranks FB first.

entries.name: Mandibuzz
entries.rationale: Hp 110 and def 105 with wings shape make a durable aerial defender who can sweep the area or cover goal; atk 65 and spa 55 offer little going forward, matching the baseline.

entries.name: Heatmor
entries.rationale: Atk 97 and spa 105 on an upright 58 kg body give real range, but a plodding anteater with spe 65 does not merit TEC 90, so it trims; abilities Gluttony and Flash Fire have no football bearing.

entries.name: Durant
entries.rationale: Spe 109 with atk 109 and def 112 on a dense 33 kg ant body gives a fast, hard-tackling runner, but height 0.3 m gives no aerial presence, so AER drops; genus Iron Ant fits a colony worker's teamwork.

entries.name: Deino
entries.rationale: Genus Irate and ability Hustle give a reckless, head-first forward, and its design has fur covering its eyes, so VIS drops; atk 65 and spe 38 keep it modest overall.

entries.name: Zweilous
entries.rationale: Two heads on a 50 kg quadruped body with atk 85 and genus Hostile make a brawling, head-first player; its covered eyes cost VIS, while two heads help it in the air.

entries.name: Hydreigon
entries.rationale: Spa 125 and atk 105 with ability Levitate make a dominant flying attacker, but its arms end in heads, so HAN drops; genus Brutal fits an aggressive, physical game.

entries.name: Larvesta
entries.rationale: Atk 85 on a 28.8 kg armor-shaped larva with spe 60 gives a blunt, middling player; its horned head helps it bump and head, but nothing in its fields calls for a change.

entries.name: Volcarona
entries.rationale: Spa 135 and spe 100 with bug-wings shape give a soaring creator who sees the whole pitch; atk 60 and weight 46 kg offer no tackling bite, and the baseline already favours creative roles.

entries.name: Cobalion
entries.rationale: Def 129 and spe 108 at weight 250 kg make a fast, unbreakable centre-back, and genus Iron Will with ability Justified fit a disciplined leader; hooves give no grip, so HAN trims.

entries.name: Terrakion
entries.rationale: Atk 129 and spe 108 on a 260 kg quadruped make a charging, powerful forward who can also anchor the defence; hooves give no grip, so HAN trims and GK leaves its best roles.

entries.name: Virizion
entries.rationale: Spd 129 and spe 108 make a resilient, graceful runner suited to covering a flank or the middle; as a hooved quadruped it has no grip on the ball in hand, so HAN trims.

entries.name: Tornadus
entries.rationale: Spe 111 and spa 125 with ability Prankster make a quick, tricky creator. Its lower body is a cloud rather than legs, and Layer 1 already applies DRI -8, TEC -7 and KIC -8 for the arms shape, so no further trim.

entries.name: Thundurus
entries.rationale: It shares Tornadus's spe 111 and atk 115 with an electric/flying type and also floats on a cloud with no legs. Layer 1 already applies DRI -8, TEC -7 and KIC -8 for the arms shape, so no further trim, leaving a quick aerial forward; ability Defiant fits its aggression.

entries.name: Reshiram
entries.rationale: Height 3.2 m and weight 330 kg with spa 150 and atk 120 make a towering defender with passing range; ACC 64 shows it is slow to start, and Layer 1 already handled its wings, so no change.

entries.name: Zekrom
entries.rationale: Atk 150 at height 2.9 m and weight 345 kg gives overwhelming power in the box at either end; ACC 67 limits sharp movement and the baseline already reflects its bulk.

entries.name: Landorus
entries.rationale: Atk 125 and spa 115 with strong arms give it handling and power, but like Tornadus it floats on a cloud without legs. Layer 1 already applies TEC -7 and KIC -8 for the arms shape, so no further trim, and goal becomes its natural home.

entries.name: Kyurem
entries.rationale: Hp 125 with atk and spa 130 at height 3.0 m and weight 325 kg give a towering, tireless central anchor; spe 95 is decent for its size, but ACC 68 shows a slow start, consistent with the baseline.

entries.name: Keldeo
entries.rationale: Spe 108 and spa 129 on a light 48.5 kg colt with kickMoves double-kick make a quick, creative attacker; as a hooved quadruped it has no grip, so HAN trims and GK falls out of its best roles.

entries.name: Meloetta
entries.rationale: Spa 128 with a singer and dancer identity and kickMoves triple-axel make a graceful playmaker, but height 0.6 m and weight 6.5 kg give no reach or strength, so HAN and PHY trim.

entries.name: Genesect
entries.rationale: Atk and spa 120 with spe 99 and kickMoves blaze-kick on a shape humanoid frame of 82.5 kg make a complete attacker, and its back-mounted cannon identity fits long-range shooting; the baseline already captures it.
